summary: Climber fell 150 feet on snow/ice in Red Gully, Crestone Peak, sustaining serious injuries; multi-agency SAR and helicopter response.
responding_agency: Saguache County SAR, Custer County SAR, Western Mountain Rescue, HAATS, EagleMed
notes: Compilation article split into four incidents. MERGED run 610: co.ng.mil 3-part SAR series Part 2 (opened this run) corroborates the 2015-07-11 Crestone Peak Red Gully 150-ft fall (Jennifer Tatnall Staufer) — HAATS UH-60 Talon 39 airlift to Crestone soccer field after ground-team rope evacuation to LZ. Run-647 merge: COARNG Part-3 HAATS retrospective (parent-opened) — names the victim Tatnall Staufer, 10-weeks-pregnant, broken femur/ribs/hypothermia; HAATS + Western MRT + Saguache/Custer SAR insertion, decision to rope-carry to PZ; also notes FFL took the Snowmass follow-on mission. CCSAR Jul-13-2015 mission report (Staufer Jul-11 Red Gully rescue, WMRT activation) merged run 733
